verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.together.ai and per-page Markdown versions that point agents to the documentation index. First-party docs also describe a Docs MCP server for live documentation lookup and 12 on-demand agent skills that teach agents correct Together AI code. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt bundle, and no independent community reports of agents successfully using these docs.
